title: Fallout: New Vegas

quotes.text: Truth is, the game was rigged from the start.
Sorry to deny you a moment of primate triumph, but you'll have to go elsewhere to sound your barbaric yawp.
You did a super job wrapping things up! And I'm not just saying that because I have to!
Obsidian built New Vegas in about 18 months, reusing Fallout 3's engine to make the deadline.
New Vegas needed an 85 on Metacritic for Obsidian's contractual bonus. It scored 84.
Every player turns on Hardcore Mode, dies of dehydration outside Goodsprings, and quietly turns it back off.
You'll spend hours deciding who deserves the Strip — NCR, Legion, House, or yourself — and still aren't sure.
You pick Wild Wasteland for the jokes, then forget you did until a UFO crashes into the road ahead.

notes: appid 22380 confirmed via Steam appdetails (type=game, name='Fallout: New Vegas', developer Obsidian Entertainment, publisher Bethesda Softworks — matches the Nexus 'newvegas' domain unambiguously, no SKU splits to resolve here). Character quotes verified verbatim against Fallout Wiki's transcribed dialogue files via its MediaWiki API (api.php?action=parse), since direct HTML fetches 403 via Cloudflare on both plain curl and WebFetch. The 85-Metacritic-bonus story is well documented (Chris Avellone confirmed it publicly); New Vegas scored 84 on PC/Xbox 360.
